name: survio-insights
description: Analyze Survio survey results like a senior survey analyst: NPS/eNPS, drivers, segment significance tests, open-text themes, wave comparison and Van Westendorp pricing, with anonymity guardrails always on. Reads Survio through the Survio MCP server or the optional survio CLI (REST API).

interface.shortDescription: Survey reports with reproducible numbers and anonymity guardrails
interface.longDescription: Reads Survio survey responses through the Survio MCP server (read tools only) or the optional survio CLI, profiles and cleans the data, runs the right statistics with a bundled dependency-free script, and writes a report that never exposes an individual respondent.
defaultPrompt: What does my latest Survio survey say?
Compare NPS between the two onboarding waves in Survio.
